description: Search active Facebook and Instagram ads by brand or keyword in one country: ad text, headline, creative links, call to action, start date and platforms. Use it when: You are studying a competitor's advertising or collecting ad creative ideas. Not for: Ad spend figures; Meta publishes those only for political and social-issue ads. Returns: 20 ads: page name, ad text, headline, image and video links, call to action, start date, platforms and active flag. Typical time: about 9 s. Price: $0.022 per search (up to 20 ads), charged only on success. One call = up to 20 ads.

country.description: Two-letter country code, uppercase, e.g. US, GB, DE; default US
